notes: These mechanics affect cultivation or harvesting. Current Garden observations do not expose their live stage or state.

behaviors.name: Dead Plant
behaviors.rule: Plants at -100 water become Dead Plants; most mature mutations also decay into them after a mutation-dependent timer, sometimes even when watered. They are inputs to Witherbloom and Zombud.

behaviors.name: Snoozling
behaviors.rule: Falls asleep at stages 5, 10 and 15; right-click to wake before growth continues.

behaviors.name: Blastberry
behaviors.rule: Harvest or decay explodes and destroys adjacent crops except other Blastberries; its explosion can produce Shellfruit from Turtlellini.

behaviors.name: Magic Jellybean
behaviors.rule: Harvestable from stage 12; drops scale at every 12 stages, up to 10x at stage 120.

behaviors.name: PlantBoy Advance
behaviors.rule: Harvest requires collecting eight apples in Snake; failure loses three growth stages.

behaviors.name: Startlevine
behaviors.rule: Harvest requires Invisibility; a neighboring Blastberry decay can destroy it.

behaviors.name: Stoplight Petal
behaviors.rule: Punch repeatedly while green to harvest; punching while red destroys the plant.

behaviors.name: Chorus Fruit
behaviors.rule: Teleports while growing and changes underlying blocks to End Stone; whether forced relocation destroys another crop needs confirmation.

behaviors.name: Glasscorn
behaviors.rule: Harvest at stage 7 or 8; another growth stage at 8 resets it to stage 1.

behaviors.name: Timestalk
behaviors.rule: Harvest spawns a Timestalk Clone; defeat the clone to obtain the mutation.
